evidence.target: opaque M8 capability boundary in RlmKernel.namespace and RlmKernel._child_handles
evidence.note: rlm_spawn and rlm_followup are exposed as bound methods, so Python code can read rlm_spawn.__self__._child_handles[h]. The map at _child_handles stores the durable id, making the claimed private id directly readable and then checkpointable if copied into a normal string global. This violates the M8 requirement that user code cannot read the child id or perform arbitrary child lookup.

pending stores only future plus owner. A live qid therefore accepts query_result, spawn_result, or followup_result regardless of which helper created it. A malformed cross-kind reply can turn a query into a handle or a spawn into a tuple instead of being rejected as a protocol fault; the M8 tests have no cross-kind or late-frame regression.
